entry.recoupedSource: BroadwayWorld forum (Apr 5, 2022), relaying the show's press rep: "Anastasia has recouped its production costs, according to a press rep." https://forum.broadwayworld.com/thread/ANASTASIA-Recoups
entry.capitalizationSource: Forbes (Aug 21, 2018), citing a production source: Anastasia "will have recouped its $12.5 million investment by the time the tour launches." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2018/08/21/anastasia-plans-massive-unconventional-international-rollout/
entry.notes: Broadway run at the Broadhurst (opened Apr 24, 2017, closed Mar 31, 2019, 808 performances). Its SEC filing allowed a capitalization of up to $15M (Broadway News); a production source put the investment at $12.5M. No recoupment was announced during the Broadway run; the press rep's April 2022 statement came after the US tour and several international productions had opened.
